title: Law to warn tourists about common NYC scams
summary: This bill would require the Department of Consumer and Worker Protection to create an outreach and education program warning tourists about common scams, including safety tips, reporting contacts and complaint instructions, posted online in multiple languages and updated yearly. It also requires DCWP to develop special materials for tourists ahead of the 2026 FIFA World Cup by June 1, 2026. The bill also makes minor wording updates to related consumer education sections of the Administrative Code.
